Bring langlearn-imagegen CLI into compliance with punt-kit/standards/cli.md. Early-stage CLI — fix patterns now while surface is small.

- Framework: typer (PASS)
- Entry point: langlearn_imagegen.cli:app (PARTIAL — should be langlearn_imagegen.__main__:app)
- version: exists but outputs bare semver, not "langlearn-imagegen <semver>"
- doctor: exists as stub (PASS)
- install: exists as stub (PASS)
- serve: exists (PASS)
- --json: exists (PASS)

## Gaps to fix

- [ ] Add `--quiet`/`-q` global flag

- [ ] Rename `evaluate-only` → flag on generate (`--evaluate-only`)
- [ ] Disable rich panels in help text
